text:
milo: quick drop 12 Simba found a sunbeam and a crinkly paper bag. he staged a full dramatic bloom. photo attached
photo-bot: uploaded image: simba_bag_bloom.jpg (1080x720)
anya: he looks like a tiny sun god rising from recyclable offerings :sun_with_face: 
ravi: that is not a cat, that is performance art. title suggestions: 1) "Recyclable Regality" 2) "Bag of Light" 3) "Simba Does Sunrise"
soph: vote 1. also who trained him to do suspenseful exits?
milo: no training, just pure audition energy.
anya: poll: bring Simba to office open-house? yes/no
photo-bot: reaction :raised_hands: added by soph
facilities-bot: note: therapy-animal policy requires prior sign-up and current vaccines. tagging @people-ops for coordination
ravi: understood. i'll help with sign-up sheet and a tiny "do not disturb" sign for his bag.
soph: i'll bring catnip toys and tiny flag with Redwood logo (optional).
milo: thanks team. Simba accepts toy offerings and a respectful 10-minute throne time in the sunbeam. :paw_prints:
anya: also i demand a slo-mo GIF for the "bag bloom". mandatory reaction for peak moments.
photo-bot: created GIF: simba_bag_bloom_slo-mo.gif
milo: filed under "if it's not on Slack it didn't happen". thank you, adoring public.
